get.description: Validate the selected provider and redirect the browser to the provider authorization page. Use this endpoint for browser-based login.

parameters.name: client_device_id
parameters.description: Optional first-party device id (e.g. UUID in localStorage). Sent only as hashed value.

parameters.name: client_timezone
parameters.description: Optional IANA timezone from the browser (e.g. Europe/Paris), e.g. from Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone. Stored as a coarse hint only.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: OAuth provider slug (github, google, or microsoft). When omitted, shows a sign-in method picker for the company.

parameters.name: redirect_to
parameters.description: Frontend callback URL. Defaults to /login/callback on current host.

200.description: Sign-in method picker HTML (when provider is omitted)

400.description: Missing redirect_to or provider not enabled

500.description: Provider is enabled but missing OAuth credentials

The response includes `device_code`, `user_code` (`XXXX-XXXX`), `verification_uri`, `verification_uri_complete`, `expires_in` (600), and `interval` (5). Poll `POST /oauth/token` with `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code`, `client_id=shellui-cli`, and `device_code`. While the person has not finished, the token endpoint returns `authorization_pending`. Polling faster than `interval` returns `slow_down` (add 5 seconds before the next poll). A denial returns `access_denied`. An unused code past `expires_in` returns `expired_token`. The device code is single-use. Codes are stored as hashes and are not logged. After approval the token response is a normal app session for that company (`access_token`, `refresh_token`, `token_type`, `expires_in`, `expires_at`), the same shape as `POST /api/v1/oauth/session`. Refresh it at `POST /api/v1/token?grant_type=refresh_token`. An MCP device code is not accepted here, and this device code is not an MCP token. Staff accounts can approve with a password or SSO. Magic link is not offered to staff. A staff CLI refresh token is capped by `CLI_STAFF_SESSION_MAX_AGE` (default 12 hours).

post.description: RFC 8628 device authorization for a company MCP resource. Send `client_id` and `resource` (`{AI_SERVICE_URL}/c/<company_id>/mcp`) as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` or JSON. The response includes `device_code`, `user_code`, `verification_uri`, `verification_uri_complete`, `expires_in` (about 10 minutes), and `interval` (5 seconds). Poll `POST /oauth/token` (or `POST /oauth/mcp/token`) with `grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code`, the same `client_id`, `device_code`, and `resource`. While the person has not finished, the token endpoint returns `authorization_pending`. Polling faster than `interval` returns `slow_down` (add 5 seconds before the next poll). A denial returns `access_denied`. An unused code past `expires_in` returns `expired_token`. The device code is single-use. Codes are stored as hashes and are not logged. After approval the token response matches the authorization-code grant: a short-lived access token and a refresh token. `aud` is the company MCP URL.

get.description: Start prompt=none. Not linked from the company sign-in page.

url.description: HTTPS webhook URL. Required when creating a rule.

company_id.description: Company the CLI is signing in to.

access_mode.description:
How new OAuth users join: Public (open), Domain (email allow list), or Invitation only (admin must enable the user).

* `public` - Public
* `domain` - Domain
* `invite` - Invitation only

allowed_email_domains.description: Lowercase domains without @ (e.g. ["acme.com"]). Used when access mode is Domain.

data_retention_days.description: Days to keep the event log, finished webhook deliveries, and revoked MCP agents (with their call logs) before "manage.py purge_expired_data" deletes them. Django admin only.

desktop_redirect_schemes.description: Lowercase custom URI schemes for desktop apps that sign in to this company, for example ["shellui-playground"]. Empty turns desktop sign-in off. A redirect is accepted when its scheme is in this list.

allow_desktop_dev_scheme.description: Accept the -dev variant of each scheme in Desktop redirect schemes when DEBUG is off. For example, shellui-playground also allows shellui-playground-dev. Off by default.

CompanyUpdate.description:
Company owner settings API. ``verified_email_domains`` and ``data_retention_days`` are
intentionally omitted; only platform operators set them in Django admin.

error_code.description: Stable machine code (for example `validation_failed`, `not_found`, `forbidden`). Never a translated sentence.

error.description: Optional human-readable detail (legacy responses may use this instead of `detail`).

field_errors.description: Optional map of field names to lists of stable error tokens (for example `required`, `invalid`).

request_id.description: Echo of the `X-Request-ID` header when present.

PatchedCompanyUpdate.description:
Company owner settings API. ``verified_email_domains`` and ``data_retention_days`` are
intentionally omitted; only platform operators set them in Django admin.

base_url.description: Required when label and is_active are omitted.

label.description: Required when base_url and is_active are omitted.

is_active.description: Required when base_url and label are omitted.

name.description: Display name. Stored as first_name (first word) and last_name (the rest).

enable_magic_link.description: Whether email magic-link sign-in is enabled for this company.

docs_slug.description: Catalog slug, for example github. Required when provider is omitted.

provider.description: Alias of docs_slug. Required when docs_slug is omitted.

ShellUIAdminUserUpdate.description:
Partial update for Django user fields plus optional Shellui user_metadata merge (`data`).

``is_active`` enables/disables ``CompanyMembership`` for the current company only.
``is_staff`` and ``is_superuser`` are not writable here: only Django admin may change them.

language.description: Invitation email language (en or fr; tags like "fr-FR" accepted). Defaults to en.

app_url.description: App URL linked from the email. An http(s) origin must match the company redirect allowlist. A desktop app uses the exact custom-scheme URI from that allowlist. Omit to send the email without a link.

language.description: UI language of the requester (e.g. "fr" or "fr-FR"). Selects the email locale.

bearerAuth.description: Shellui access token or personal access token (PAT): Authorization: Bearer <token>
